annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker describes participation and reinvestment in a lending platform and emphasizes daily interest. The displayed Hextracoin dashboard separately links an investment balance to credited interest and displayed earnings; those figures are not verified realized returns.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes Hexacoin as a lending platform and states a threshold for reinvesting.
evidence.quote: Hexacoin is a whole different lending platform you gotta wait every hundred to reinvest

evidence.observation: The speaker characterizes the lending-related interest favorably.
The speaker gives a favorable opinion of the program.
evidence.quote: extra coin most definitely a good program in my opinion

evidence.observation: The speaker directs viewers to description links and says they can sign up, without identifying a single destination for that invitation.
evidence.quote: everything that you've seen today so far you can go in the description link and you can sign up

evidence.observation: A Hextracoin dashboard displays Total Investment of $100.00, Active Investment of $100.00, Total Earned of $27.35, a Gold Lending option, and a credited-interest history.
The speaker talks through a reinvestment; the ASR alone does not establish that a transaction completed.
evidence.quote: I was going to reinvest that badly but I can see this $2.30, $1.40. Loving and let's go ahead and re-invest that bad boy. Confirm that. Close.

evidence.observation: The speaker acknowledges uncertainty about the crypto activity.
evidence.quote: we're all taking a chance we don't know this gonna work or not

evidence.observation: The speaker qualifies the trading analysis as projections rather than a signal or financial advice.
evidence.quote: this is not a signal these are just projections I'm not giving any financial advice

evidence.observation: The speaker distinguishes buying cryptocurrency from earning it through free faucets.
evidence.quote: you can either buy it out right or you can earn it through these free faucets of sorts and things like that

evidence.observation: A free-bitcoin page shows reward-points language and text asking the user to fill in a CAPTCHA for a free-bitcoin amount; a browser overlay obscures part of the page.
A QoinPro member dashboard presents daily free coins and a separate referral step inviting members to refer others to earn more.
